leadRow.title: Guidance: OFSI General licence INT/2025/5635700
leadRow.source: Primary / UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation / 2026-08-06

evidence.organisation: UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation
evidence.significance: OFSI amended a Russia-related general licence on 6 August. Firms with relevant counterparties or activity should identify the change, record the applicability decision, update the sanctions-control evidence and retain the versioned rationale.

evidence.sourceTitle: CISA Adds One Known Exploited Vulnerability to Catalog

evidence.significance: A new CISA Known Exploited Vulnerability entry is evidence of active exploitation. Prioritise asset discovery, patch and compensating-control decisions, exception ownership and recovery proof over generic vulnerability reporting.
